subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): reject oversized apply body files

question: Should `openclaw wiki apply synthesis --body-file` adopt a hard 1 MiB maximum for existing user-supplied Markdown files, and if so what compatibility and documentation contract should users receive?
rationale: The implementation prevents unbounded buffering, but the proposed fixed limit deliberately changes a public CLI workflow; source review cannot determine whether maintainers intend that new restriction.

options.title: Approve and document the 1 MiB contract
options.body: Keep a fixed limit only after documenting the user-facing cap and validating the resulting upgrade behavior for existing large-file users.

options.title: Use an approved compatibility-preserving policy
options.body: Replace the arbitrary cap with a maintainer-approved bounded-processing design that avoids silently breaking current large-file workflows.

options.title: Pause the cap change
options.body: Do not merge a new rejection policy until an owner confirms that the availability benefit outweighs the workflow breakage.

recommendation.title: Use an approved compatibility-preserving policy
recommendation.body: Replace the arbitrary cap with a maintainer-approved bounded-processing design that avoids silently breaking current large-file workflows.
